name: hubspot-booking-sync
description: Scheduled sync service that matches HubSpot records to Tourism HQ booking codes and batch-updates deposit_count with each code's pax count

scripts.test:tourism: node --input-type=module -e "import 'dotenv/config'; import axios from 'axios'; const url = process.env.TOURISM_HQ_API_URL ?? 'https://booking.tourismhq.com/api/scoreboard'; try { const { data } = await axios.get(url, { timeout: 10000 }); console.log(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)); } catch (e) { console.error(e.response?.status ?? e.code, e.response?.data ?? e.message); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.test:hubspot: node --input-type=module -e "import 'dotenv/config'; import axios from 'axios'; const base = process.env.HUBSPOT_API_URL ?? 'https://api.hubapi.com'; const id = process.env.HUBSPOT_OBJECT_ID; try { const { data } = await axios.get(base + '/crm/v3/objects/' + id, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + process.env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN }, params: { limit: 5, properties: 'booking_code,deposit_count,manager_email' }, timeout: 10000 }); console.log(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)); } catch (e) { console.error(e.response?.status ?? e.code, e.response?.data ?? e.message); process.exit(1); }"

author: Muhammad Aqib
